div.div:
All CPUs now have the samples [4, 10, 30]. In practice this means that:
- CPU 0 will receive all data below 4
- CPU 1 will receive all data from 4 up to 10 (excluded)
- CPU 2 will receive all data from 10 up to 30

Step 4: Each CPU sends the portion of its segments to the corresponding CPU, as given by
the samples, and sorts the data it receives. As the samples split the range of values in the
order of the CPU ranks, the final data is sorted across all CPUs.
